moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Sales leads and opportunities
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: find#Opportunities: the leads (typeEnumId SotLead) and opportunities (SotOpportunity) the user may see in Sales (their own and their teams', or their organizations' for a manager), narrowed by text, organizationPartyId, mine (Y), ownerPartyId, teamPartyId, salesPipelineId, opportunityStageId, statusId (SalesOppOpen, SalesOppWon, SalesOppLost or closed), closeFrom and closeThru (yyyy-MM-dd), accountPartyId and dataSourceId, paged; each with its account, stage, amount, probability, expected close, owner, team and next activity, and the totals by currency.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: New lead or opportunity
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: create#Opportunity: a lead (typeEnumId SotLead: no account or stage needed) or an opportunity (SotOpportunity, the default) of an organization of the user's sales scope (organizationPartyId; ask which when none is active), with its name, account, contact, pipeline and stage, owner or team, amount and currency and expected close. The user approves it first.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Move an opportunity to a stage
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: move#Opportunity: an open deal to a current stage of its pipeline (opportunityStageId), at the revision read with find#Opportunities (expectedRevision); a stage move is not a closure. The user approves it first.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Close a lead or opportunity
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: close#Opportunity: an open deal closed Won or Lost (Lost needs a current lost reason), at the revision read (expectedRevision); a lead closed Lost is disqualified. The user approves it first.

artifactGroups.description: Sales: the quote services Assist's tools call

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Sales quotes
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: find#Quotes: the quotes the user may see in Sales (their own and their teams', or their organizations' for a manager), narrowed by text, organizationPartyId, customerPartyId, salesOpportunityId, mine (Y), state (open, draft, proposed, cancelled or all) and validity (expiring or expired), paged; each with its customer, total, validity, owner and revision (orderRevision, which send needs).

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Approvals a quote needs
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: preview#Quote: the approval rules a quote (orderId) meets at its revision, each with what meets it, the approver it needs and its state (needs approval, waiting, approved, refused). It shows no cost.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Send a quote
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: send#Quote: a proposed quote (orderId) issued and sent at the revision read with find#Quotes (orderRevision) to recipientPartyIds (the customer or its contacts; empty for the quote's contact), from the user's own mail (sendMode own, the quote's owner) or the organization's (organization); previewOnly Y first says who gets it and the PDF's name. Needs an operationKey. The user approves it first.

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Forecast

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.basis: Deals expected to close in the period, as of a time

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Open pipeline
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: The estimated amount of open qualified opportunities, in each deal's own currency, as of a time.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.dateBasis: As of a time, from the deal's audit log
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Open (not Won or Lost) opportunities; leads apart
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.numerator: The sum of the deals' estimated amounts
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.additiveDimensions: stage, source, owner, team, age (within one currency)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.allowedDimensions: stage, source, owner, team, age, currency
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.supportedFilters: organizationPartyId, teamPartyId, ownerPartyId, salesPipelineId, opportunityStageId, dataSourceId, currencyUomId, asOfDate
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Leads, won and lost deals; a deal with no estimate is counted apart, never as zero
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.drillContract: The open deals of the selected bucket
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.freshness: Live; the dataset by the MantleSalesPipeline feed

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Weighted pipeline
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Open qualified opportunities' estimated amounts times their probability, in each deal's own currency, as of a time.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.dateBasis: As of a time, from the deal's audit log
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Open (not Won or Lost) opportunities; leads apart
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.numerator: The sum of each deal's estimated amount times its probability (stage or manual)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.additiveDimensions: stage, source, owner, team, age (within one currency)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.allowedDimensions: stage, source, owner, team, age, currency
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.supportedFilters: organizationPartyId, teamPartyId, ownerPartyId, salesPipelineId, opportunityStageId, dataSourceId, currencyUomId, asOfDate
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Leads, won and lost deals; a deal with no estimate or no probability adds nothing and is named
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.drillContract: The open deals of the selected bucket

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Won value
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: The estimated amount of opportunities closed won in a period, in each deal's own currency; not invoiced revenue.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Won, each deal once by its final outcome as of the report time
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.numerator: The sum of the won deals' estimated amounts at their close
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.additiveDimensions: owner, team, account, source, period (within one currency)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.allowedDimensions: owner, team, account, source, currency, period
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.supportedFilters: organizationPartyId, teamPartyId, ownerPartyId, accountPartyId, dataSourceId, currencyUomId, fromDate, thruDate
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Leads; a deal reopened after the report time counts by its outcome then
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.drillContract: The won deals of the period

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Win rate
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Won opportunities over won and lost opportunities closed in a period.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Won and lost opportunities, each deal once by its final outcome as of the report time
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.supportedFilters: organizationPartyId, teamPartyId, ownerPartyId, accountPartyId, dataSourceId, fromDate, thruDate
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Leads disqualified before qualification are counted apart, never in the denominator
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.drillContract: The won and lost deals of the period
